title: The Blue Book briefing folders of 160 remote viewing successes

tellings.quote: we had What's called the Blue Book the blue briefing books it was two books two folders with 160 successes in it

plain: A secret Army team at Fort Meade, Maryland, which practised remote viewing (trying to describe faraway places and things by the mind alone), kept two blue briefing folders holding 160 of its successes, according to Joe McMoneagle, who says he was one of its remote viewers. He calls them "the Blue Book, the blue briefing books", a name not to be confused with the Air Force's old UFO study. He tells it as proof that the work produced results worth showing to officials.
